reference.title: SaaS launch film (signal serif)
reference.notes: Type is the hero and the visual is one idea: an orange dot becomes a radar origin, a sweep, ring pulses and finally the logo. Huge soft serif lines roll through masks as an anaphora with orange accent words; the espresso-to-cream flip is the problem-to-solution chapter break. Studied from what the page shows publicly; rebuilt in Moovi's own code (packages/library/src/kits/launch) with our own fonts, sounds and assets.

parts.name: Hero headline
parts.about: one line alone, centred and big (9-14% of the frame), an eyebrow above, a quiet sub below; the cast type treatment moves it

parts.name: Anaphora stack
parts.about: phrases arrive one under another; each earlier phrase dims as the next one lands

parts.name: Lateral drift
parts.about: a slow sideways drift across the beat at 3% scale (direction alternates beat to beat)

parts.name: Score ring
parts.about: a circular ring sweeps while its score counts up in the middle

parts.name: Ranked list rows
parts.about: rows with an avatar, a name, a quiet sub line and a right badge stagger in; the active row lifts onto a card

parts.name: Chat bubble
parts.about: a sent or received message bubble that pops from its tail corner

parts.name: Hairline grid
parts.about: a faint architect's grid with a slightly stronger centre cross

parts.name: Concentric rings
parts.about: faint concentric rings around a point, slowly breathing outward (the radar world)

parts.name: Warm mesh
parts.about: two or three soft colour fields (peach and the accent's tint) drifting very slowly over cream

parts.name: Corner ticks and time code
parts.about: four thin corner ticks, a mono running time code and the host: camera-frame chrome, used sparingly

parts.role: the hook: a late-night question to the founder
parts.name: Night question
parts.about: a centred soft serif question rises word by word on a dark ground, a dim out-of-focus screen glows far behind and a tiny clock races past midnight

parts.name: Prospect list grind
parts.about: a big app window of prospect rows that flick past while the tab strip multiplies and a sent counter climbs against zero replies; a draft is typed, selected and deleted over it

parts.name: Sonar lights the points
parts.about: one accent dot sends thin sonar rings across scattered grey points; each point a ring passes turns accent and blooms

parts.name: Radar finds signals
parts.about: a radar with a bearing scale and an accent sweep wedge turning clockwise; each signal it passes rings, blooms and slides out a labelled chip

parts.role: choosing the one lead that matters
parts.name: Radar lock-on
parts.about: the sweep slows onto one signal, corner brackets snap round it with an accent score tag, every other signal blurs away

parts.name: Lead card unfolds
parts.about: the accent dot becomes an avatar and a white lead card unfolds around it in real perspective while the score counts up; defocused cards sit further back

parts.role: the product writes and sends the message
parts.name: Message typed and sent
parts.about: a sequence card stacks over the lead card, the message ghost-types with an accent caret, the cursor presses Send and the card whips off on speed lines

parts.name: Reply drops in
parts.about: a reply notification drops from above with velocity ghosts and settles on a spring over a defocused inbox; rings pulse from its avatar, then the card leaves only its dot

parts.name: Petals orbit into the mark
parts.about: the dot pulses, four coloured quarter petals burst onto an orbit ring, circle, converge and turn ink into the brand mark (or the real logo)

parts.role: the four-step product story in one beat
parts.name: One clause per chapter
parts.about: a numbered chapter index fills hairline by hairline while a big serif clause per item rises and sinks in the corner and a segmented dial counts the steps

parts.name: Serif odometer
parts.about: one big serif number whose digits roll like a mechanical counter, accent suffix, hairline and label, with the brand signals orbiting at depth

parts.name: Mark slides, wordmark, CTA
parts.about: the mark spins in and slides left while the wordmark letters reveal behind a mask, the tagline lands at reading pace with its last word in the accent, an accent CTA rises on a soft glow

parts.name: Serif word mask rise
parts.about: each word slides up one full em out of its own line mask and stops dead, the accent word a hair late

parts.role: clauses that hand over to the next scene
parts.name: Rise, then sink
parts.about: the line rises out of its mask and, before the cut, sinks back down into it word by word

parts.name: Ghost typing
parts.about: characters type in with the newest three still fading and an accent caret after them

parts.name: Reading-pace words
parts.about: words land at a spoken rhythm (syllables and pauses), each rising 14 px; the accent word turns to the accent last

parts.name: Tilted spring rise
parts.about: the next shot shoots up from below as a card, tilted a few degrees with vertical ghosts, overshoots and settles level

parts.role: the grind collapses to one point
parts.name: Shot drains into the dot
parts.about: the shot breathes, drains to grey, then shrinks with growing blur into one accent dot

parts.name: Dot flood, then day iris
parts.about: the accent dot inflates exponentially into a full-frame flash with stepped echo bands, then the next world opens as a disc from the centre

parts.name: Send whip with streaks
parts.about: the shot winds back a few px, whips off right in a smear and leaves thin accent and grey streaks that fade

parts.name: Dive into the point
parts.about: the camera dives onto the exit dot in log space and the next shot opens out of that dot as a disc

parts.name: Card stacks over
parts.about: the next shot slides up and over as a card while the old one stays behind, higher, smaller, defocused and dimmed

parts.role: radar and card scenes never freeze
parts.name: Float drift
parts.about: a slow noise-driven float with a gentle push and a hair of roll, never still

parts.role: dive onto the locked radar point
parts.name: Dive to the exit point
parts.about: floats, then in the last half second dives five times closer onto the exit point, ending centred on it

parts.name: Frosted karaoke subtitle
parts.about: a dark frosted pill holding the spoken line, the current word lit in the accent

parts.name: Time-lapse clock
parts.about: an accent dot and a tabular clock racing minutes past midnight, the changed digit rolling

parts.name: Sent vs replies
parts.about: two header pills: sent ticking up, replies frozen at zero in a warm red tint

parts.name: Prospect list window
parts.about: a light app window with a multiplying tab strip, search field, counters and avatar rows that flick past with ghosts

parts.name: Draft that gets rewritten
parts.about: a compose popover types a message, selects it all in an accent tint, deletes it and starts again

parts.name: Signal chip
parts.about: a ring circles a found point, the point blooms in its signal colour and a label chip slides out of blur beside it (with a leader line when nudged)

parts.name: Reticle with score tag
parts.about: four corner brackets snap round a point with a small accent score tag above

parts.name: Lead score card in perspective
parts.about: a white lead card with avatar, name, role, a counting score with signal bars, company, chips and an AI insight line, drawn in per-slice perspective

parts.name: Sequence message card
parts.about: a card with step chips, subject, a ghost-typed body with an accent caret and an accent Send button that presses

parts.name: Reply notification drop
parts.about: a reply card drops from above with velocity ghosts, settles on a spring, and two accent rings pulse from its avatar

parts.name: Numbered chapter eyebrow
parts.about: an accent index number, a hairline that draws, and the chapter word sliding in

parts.name: Warm glow with arcs
parts.about: a slow accent-tinted glow drifting in a corner, corner shade, and giant faint arcs breathing across the frame

parts.name: Radar rings and bearing scale
parts.about: hairline rings, a crosshair and an outer degree scale labelled every 30 deg, turning very slowly

parts.name: Ring pulse
parts.about: two thin accent rings expand from a point and fade, repeating

uses.role: base of the serif word mask rise (ours travels a full em, no fade)
subtitle pill with the spoken word lit
sub-frame ghosts on the card rise, collapse, whip and drop
cursor travels to the Send button
the back card steps back behind the stacked card
radar ground kept behind later scenes
